title: CWTS Leiden Ranking 2017
authors: Centre for Science and Technology Studies
descriptions: This data set provides the statistics made available in the 2017 edition of the CWTS Leiden Ranking. The Leiden Ranking 2017 is a bibliometric ranking of 903 major universities worldwide.

data_sources: The CWTS Leiden Ranking 2017 is based on bibliographic data from the Web of Science database produced by Clarivate Analytics. The Web of Science database consists of a number of citation indices. The Leiden Ranking uses data from the Science Citation Index Expanded, the Social Sciences Citation Index, and the Arts & Humanities Citation Index.
